# ModEngine third-party files

This folder contains files from **ModEngine** by Katalash:

- `dinput8_modengine.dll` — the original ModEngine `dinput8.dll`, renamed so this MOD can
  chain-load it from its own `dinput8.dll` proxy.
- `modengine.ini` — the matching configuration. `modOverrideDirectory` remains `\mods`.

Upstream project: <https://github.com/katalash/ModEngine>

The upstream repository does not currently declare an explicit license. These files are included
only to make the release bundle usable as-is. All rights remain with the original author; if you
are the author and want them removed, open an issue in this repository.
